intro: Between late April and mid-May 2026, ZCyberNews covered five high- and critical-severity incidents tied to the tag check-point-research. The most prominent threat actor observed was Handala Hack, alongside Silver Dragon and The Gentlemen. Key vulnerabilities exploited included CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. Affected sectors spanned government, critical infrastructure, software consultancy, and telecommunications, with incidents reported across Europe, Israel, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Turkey.
